observations: Front view of a sage green electric scooter or moped.
Rectangular LED headlight assembly with a prominent yellow bezel.
Handlebars, brake levers, and side mirrors are visible.
A decorative sticker with vertical stripes and a circular emblem is on the front fairing.
The scooter is parked outdoors on mossy ground next to a concrete wall and a fence with barbed wire.
A black plastic cover or bag is partially visible on the left side.

claims.evidence: Only a partial front view is provided; the condition of the seat, tires, and rear is unknown.
The front fairing shown in photo 0 appears free of major scratches or dirt.
Battery health cannot be determined from a static photo.
The remote control unit is not pictured.

risks.risk: The motor or controller may be faulty, masked by the 'dead battery' claim.
risks.proof: A video of the scooter running/wheels spinning using a temporary power source.

risks.risk: High cost of battery replacement (Lead-acid vs Lithium).
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment and the battery labels.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full set of new high-capacity batteries

risks.risk: Significant hidden damage to the frame, seat, or rear components.
risks.proof: Photos showing the full left side, right side, and rear of the scooter.
risks.if_unproven: as having major cosmetic and structural defects

proof_requests: Photos of the entire scooter from both sides and the rear.
A photo of the dashboard/odometer to check mileage and brand.
A photo of the battery compartment showing the type and number of batteries.
A photo of the remote starter and keys.
A video showing the lights or display turning on (if possible).
response.reason: Only one partial photo of the front is provided. It is impossible to value a vehicle without seeing its full condition, tires, and identifying the specific model or battery requirements, especially when it is described as non-running.
